The main takeaway from our work is that

the p19Arf tumor suppressor protein is not essential for normal embryonic development, but the N-terminally shortened smArf polypeptide, which is not expressed in normal tissues of wild-type mice, is sufficient to correct two focal developmental defects of mice that lack p19Arf.
